description: One dancer walks a small circle on the spot and returns to their place.

walkthrough.line: On your own, walk a small circle to the {hand} and come back to your place.
walkthrough.teach: Walk a small circle round to your {hand}, turning as you go, and come back to the place you started from facing the way you were facing. Your hands stay at your sides: somebody else is dancing a figure of their own beside you, so keep it small and stay clear of them.
